verdict.rationale: DBOS has hosted components (DBOS Conductor and DBOS Cloud) that handle customer workflow data, so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence addresses AI model training, opt-outs, or data-use policy. Self-hosting Conductor or running the open-source library on your own Postgres is an architectural workaround, not a documented no-training control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
